answer: The Combined Sustainability Statement received limited assurance. Reasonable assurance covered Total energy consumption, GHG gross emissions Scopes 1 and 2 (market-based), and Scope 2 location-based emissions. References outside the combined management report and references marked additional information that point elsewhere and are not designated as sustainability reporting were excluded. The limited conclusion used the negative-form ‘nothing has come to our attention’; the reasonable-assurance disclosures received a positive compliance opinion. The engagement followed ISAE 3000 (Revised), and limited procedures were less extensive and yielded substantially lower assurance than reasonable assurance.
